## About
Gasparini Tires is a neighborhood tire shop in Miami. We fix flats, rotate tires, sell new and used tires, and do alignments.
We'll walk you through your options, new or used, and tell you what makes sense for your car. No pushing repairs you don't need. Got a question or want a quote? Stop by, call, or email info@gasparinitires.net.

## Services
- New and used tires: We sell both, and we'll explain the benefits of each so you can pick what fits.
- Flats and rotations: Flat repairs, tire rotations and tire changes.
- Alignment: Get your alignment done along with new tires. One reviewer said the car drove smooth afterward.

## FAQ
Q: Can I bring in tires I bought online?
A: Yes. A longtime customer says he brings us new tires he bought online and we install them.

Q: Do you sell used tires?
A: Yes, new and used. We'll explain the difference and the benefits of each.
